name: Series Studio
description: Episodic video series production with recurring, consistent characters: a Showrunner org that scripts episodes into shot lists, keeps a character bible (portraits + turnarounds + bound voices), generates identity-consistent scene clips with shot-to-shot continuity (FAL Kling/Veo/Seedance/Vidu/Sora or direct LTX-2.5), and assembles captioned episodes — all recorded as structured state in the persistent series library. Install the series-library, fal-cinema, ltx-video, fal-avatar, fal-image, elevenlabs-voice, openai-tts, video-composer and ffmpeg-guide skill templates first (the Studio UI setup does this automatically), then assign a provider/model to the five agents.
author: AT

variables.description: FAL.ai API key — character portraits/turnarounds, reference-to-video scene generation, continuity shots, Sora characters.
LTX API key — direct LTX-2.5 Fast/Pro text, image and audio-to-video generation through api.ltx.io.
ElevenLabs API key — per-character cloned voices + dialogue TTS. Optional: openai-tts is used as fallback when unset.
OpenAI API key — fallback TTS and Whisper subtitle generation. Optional.
